feat(camellia): migrate capability admin page

Summary:
- add the dedicated Camellia capability management page with list,
  modal editing, locale gating, and full asset upload coverage
- extend the shared woodii API client and exports for capability list,
  modify, and remove operations
- wire the capability route, navigation, keyboard shortcut help, and
  localized copy into the current Camellia admin shell

Rationale:
- capability was the final missing Batch 1 surface in DAM-63 after the
  content-management pages landed
- the page fits the current flat CRUD scaffold better than the legacy
  Woodii Vuetify composition, so the migration can finish without
  adding new archetypes
